infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID authorizes a payment this wallet signs itself. Your keys never leave this device, and a signature is refused if it is not you.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is how this wallet reads a signature back from your vault. It is the only channel between the two halves, and nothing is ever sent anywhere else.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only to reach a node you run yourself, at an address you typed in. The wallet never searches your network and talks to nothing on it that you did not name.
